description:
[Results] Get the merchant's credit usage.

Per-event credit-usage ledger for a merchant: every billable analytics event (interview, pre-screening, public avatar, simulation, …) that consumed credits, ordered most recent first. Scoped to your token's merchant, or a merchant_id override for admins / sub-merchant operators. The credits consumed by each event are in stats.credit_amount. Capped at 1000 records per page.

conversation_id.description: Pass the exact conversation_id from the server's previous response, unchanged. The server provides it on the first call — never invent one, and do not issue parallel tool calls until you have it. Keep passing the same conversation_id for the rest of the conversation, including after later user messages or on a different task; do not reset it when the user starts a new request.

interview_id.description: Optional interview (interview_def_set) or position (position_def_set) id to drill the credit-usage ledger down to a single interview or position. The type is detected automatically: for a position the response combines pre-screening and interview-result credits across the whole position; for an interview it returns that interview's credit events (including simulations and report translations).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1–1000).

merchant_id.description: Optional merchant to scope to. Admins and sub-merchant operators only; other callers always use their token's merchant.

offset.description: Number of records to skip from the start of the result set.

name: get_merchant_credit_usage

data.description: Credit-consuming analytics events for the merchant, most recent first. Each row is one billable event; the credits it consumed are in stats.credit_amount.

candidate_name.description: Candidate display name from the linked profile interview, when available.

credit_amount.description: Number of credits deducted by this event, surfaced from stats.credit_amount for convenience. Null when the amount is absent.

event.description: Billable event type that consumed the credit (e.g. interview, interview_reviewing, interview_failed, interview_incomplete, pre_screening, candidate_report_translation, candidate_kyc, public_avatar, interview_simulation).

object_uuid.description: Primary object the event refers to (e.g. the interview result / attempt).

parent_object_uuid.description: Parent object of the event (e.g. the interview definition), when applicable.

profile_interview_id.description: Candidate enrolment (profile interview) id, when linked.

stats.description: Event stats JSON. Contains credit_amount (the credits consumed by this event) plus event-specific fields.

has_more.description: True when more records exist beyond this page (offset + returned < total).

limit.description: Page size used for this response.

total.description: Total matching records across all pages.

title: Get merchant credit usage
